mechanism: Both drugs can cause renal impairment and hypotension; zoledronic acid increases renal dysfunction risk while irbesartan may mask compensatory mechanisms, requiring careful monitoring of renal function and electrolytes.
action: Monitor serum creatinine, eGFR, and electrolytes (especially calcium and phosphate) at baseline and regularly during concurrent use; assess blood pressure; ensure adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusions.
